item.title: 2027 Team Infinite sponsorship applications are now open
item.description:
Infinite Discs has opened applications for the 2027 Team Infinite, its sponsored-player program — and with October winding down, the window to apply is closing soon. The application is a simple form linked at the end of the blog post, open to players looking to join the Team Infinite ranks for next season.

Sponsorship teams like this are one of the main ways disc golfers get support for travel, entry fees, and gear as they move up the competitive ladder. If you've been thinking about applying for a manufacturer or retailer team for 2027, this is the nudge: get the application in before the deadline passes.

Sources

  • Infinite Discs Blog: 2027 Team Infinite Applications Are Now Open

item.title: What understable, stable, and overstable actually mean for your disc selection
item.description:
Foundation Disc Golf published a plain-English explainer on disc stability — the understable, stable, and overstable ratings that describe how a disc flies for a right-hand backhand throw. Understable discs turn right before fading, overstable discs resist turning and finish with a strong left fade, and stable discs hold a straight line between the two extremes.

It's one of the most important concepts for buying the right disc: understanding stability is what lets you match a disc to your arm speed and the shot shape you need, rather than just picking a popular mold. Worth a read if you've ever wondered why a disc doesn't fly the way its numbers suggested.

Sources

  • Foundation Disc Golf: Understable vs. Overstable Disc Golf Discs: What's the Difference?

item.title: DGPT fan sinks $10,000 putt on Championship Sunday
item.description:
The biggest winner at Ivy Hill Golf Club on Championship Sunday may have been someone who wasn't on the leaderboard. Graham Clawson won the Disc Golf Pro Tour's Powerball Putt contest, a fan putting competition held during the championship, and walked away with $10,000.

The Lynchburg, Virginia event closed out the weekend with the fan contest running alongside the pro rounds. Clawson outlasted the competition in the putting contest to claim the prize — a nice reminder that the DGPT's fan activations are becoming a real draw in their own right, and that sometimes the most dramatic putt of the day comes from the gallery.

Sources

  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: Disc Golf Pro Tour Fan Wins $10,000 During Powerball® Putt
